title: A2UI Status Component Catalog
description: Semantic status badges, segmented progress bars, and collapsible sections for A2UI v1.0 surfaces.

Badge.description: Renders a compact, semantic status pill with an optional icon or activity pulse dot.

text.description: Label text displayed inside the badge pill.

tone.description: Semantic tone controlling pill background, border, and text color (defaults to 'neutral').

icon.description: Optional icon name from the A2UI icon set rendered before the badge text.

pulse.description: When true, renders a subtle pulsing indicator dot inside the badge.

weight.description: The relative weight of this component within a Row or Column.

ProgressBar.description: Renders a single-value or multi-segment horizontal progress track with optional header labels or auto-tallied status items. Mode precedence when multiple inputs are supplied: segments > items > value.

value.description: Completed numeric value in single-bar mode.

max.description: Maximum numeric value in single-bar mode (defaults to 100) or optional total track denominator in segments mode when greater than the segment sum.

segments.description: Explicit array of {value, tone, label} segments rendered proportionally across the track.

items.description: Array of status items (such as progress_board $/items) automatically tallied by each item's tone (items without tone default to neutral).

label.description: Optional heading label rendered above the left end of the progress track.

summary.description: Optional summary text rendered above the right end of the progress track.

indeterminate.description: When true, renders an animated indeterminate shimmer across the progress track.

weight.description: The relative weight of this component within a Row or Column.

Collapsible.description: Renders an expandable disclosure section with a clickable header, optional summary and badge, and a child component body.

title.description: Header title text for the collapsible section.

child.description: The ID of the child component rendered inside the collapsible body when expanded.

summary.description: Optional muted summary text displayed in the header row.

badge.description: Optional ID of a Badge or Text component rendered on the right side of the header row.

open.description: Whether the section is expanded (defaults to false; supports two-way DataBinding).

weight.description: The relative weight of this component within a Row or Column.
